manifest.description: Surfaces your digarr recommendations on Discover, so you can hear an artist before approving it into Lidarr.

url.label: digarr URL
url.description: Base URL of your digarr instance, reachable from the Music Assistant container.

api_key.label: API key
api_key.description: A digarr API key with the 'read' and 'write' scopes. Create one in digarr under Settings -> Account.

ma_user.label: Music Assistant user
ma_user.description: Only this user sees this instance's Discover row. Each digarr user gets their own instance and their own key.

min_score.label: Minimum score
min_score.description: Hide recommendations digarr scored below this value.
